native_checkpoint_probe.reason: Native SerializableRun is not a complete mid-combat checkpoint. Retain native replay restoration.

multi_lane_fixture_assertion.reason: Equal final HP; selected native-verified candidate uses fewer actions, so fixture-specific choice is absent from selected output. Unselected lane recorded a valid two-card native selection. Directed single-lane coverage is tested separately.

eight_workers.reason: Insufficient available physical memory margin for eight copies of the measured native heaps plus host; do not force paging.

shared_queue_boundary: Deduplicates task submissions. Every proposal still executes native effects; common action prefixes and scenes are still restored for each route.
